status: Concept review only. No live effect appearance changed.
capture: Fresh production Game Play Mode captures will be saved in this folder.
source_findings: Tornado funnel is an opaque mesh. Its shader computes alpha but returns 1, so tint alpha does not soften the silhouette.
Tsunami is a GPU-deformed surface with capped collision-free spray. Its material properties are copied from the ocean each frame.
implementation_limits: Appearance ideas are not measured performance improvements. Quest needs device GPU profiling.
Maintain the existing tsunami surface/collision profile for a visual-only implementation. A true overturning barrel would require a separate collision decision.
Avoid layering large transparent surfaces over the entire screen.
